findings.interpretation: Sicker-than-average panel (only 5% low-complexity), but the 99215 share is about 3x peers in every complexity group, including patients with 0-2 conditions. findings.headline: Highest risk-adjusted outlier (15.5); 24% 99215 on patients with zero chronic conditions vs 2.3% for peers; notes look inflated
findings.interpretation: Weaker kind of evidence: charts support the billed level (1 of 44 below billed), but 45% of notes address fewer problems than the billed level implies, 20% are signed late, and 16% claim data review with no matching test on the claim.
